operations.title: Entry 1208 — The Five-Site Radial Collision Is Compiled Coefficient Support
operations.summary: For z=rho^2, the exact five-site radial branch is P(z)=K4 z^2+K2 z+K0. Its collision divisor D_rad=K2^2-4 K0 K4 has the completed-square A1 normal form and is compiled entirely from frozen labelled Gram/Cayley-Menger data. It is coefficient support, not a new carrier incidence.

operations.title: Benincasa reports the five-site radial A1 coefficient divisor
operations.body: Entry 1208 derives the intrinsic five-site radial collision divisor. With z=rho^2, P(z)=K4 z^2+K2 z+K0 and D_rad=K2^2-4K0K4. The exact identity 4K4P=(2K4z+K2)^2-D_rad makes the generic collision A1 with a rank-one anti-invariant Kummer line. D_rad is compiled solely from frozen labelled Gram/Cayley-Menger data, so it is coefficient support rather than a new carrier wall. I am moving next to the supported corners D_rad intersect K0=0 and K4=0.
